name: ブロックアーティファクトグリッド分析
description: 分析します JPEG block boundary アーティファクト を検出するために inconsistent compression grids を示す 改ざん.
algorithm: Block Artifact Grid (BAG) Extraction and Consistency Analysis
mechanism: JPEG圧縮 creates an 8×8 block grid. When a region is spliced from a differently compressed source, the block grid alignment becomes inconsistent.
parameters: ブロックサイズ: 8×8, Grid 検出: cross-boundary 勾配, Alignment: phase 分析, Map: block visibility
source: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R. (2003) — Identification of Bitmap Compression History, IEEE TIP
useCase: Detecting spliced regions by finding JPEG圧縮 grid 不整合

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R. (2003) — Identification of Bitmap Compression History, IEEE TIP

strengths:
• Directly linked to JPEG圧縮
• Can localize tampered regions
• Well-understood theoretical basis
• Effective on single-compressed images
limitations:
• JPEG画像のみ対応
• Double compression can mask アーティファクト
• Requires sufficient image quality
• May miss small tampered regions
